description: Header file defining the NetworkDelegate class, which manages network event subscriptions, notifications, and interface status retrieval within a plugin framework. It includes methods for handling network events, querying network interfaces, and dispatching network status changes.

classes.name: NetworkDelegate
classes.description: Manages network event subscriptions, notifications, and interface status queries, interfacing with the INetworkManager and dispatching network change events.

classes.name: NetworkNotificationHandler
classes.description: Inner class implementing INetworkManager::INotification to handle network status change callbacks and dispatch events.

methods.name: HandleSubscription
methods.description: Handles subscribing or unsubscribing to network events based on the listen flag.

methods.name: HandleEvent
methods.description: Checks if an event is a valid network event and handles subscription accordingly.

methods.name: GetNetworkManagerInterface
methods.description: Retrieves the INetworkManager interface, querying via the shell if necessary.

methods.name: GetInternetConnectionStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current internet connection status by querying available network interfaces.
